ModMetaData.name: Kroffa Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces BiomesTeam.BiomesPollutedLands' BMT_Maligoat art and label/description (primary look, south/east/north facings only - the dessicated-corpse textures stay on donor art) per the 2026-09-11 owner ruling on `art: "improve"` rows: non-SW names are free to be reimagined (general kind fixed, specific name/character not). BMT_Maligoat is reimagined as **Kroffa**, a six-legged plated desert grazer with curling horns and mandible-like mouthparts - not a literal goat. Full regeneration, heavy black outline required.
The donor splits every life stage by gender (BMT_PollutedLands/Things/ Animal/Maligoat/MaligoatMale and MaligoatFemale) - only one look was generated for this wave, so the SAME new art is wired to BOTH MaligoatMale_<facing> and MaligoatFemale_<facing> rather than leaving does on the old donor look (same reasoning as AnoobaArtOverride).
defName is NOT renamed (donor mod's def, not ours - see GritheArtOverride for the same reasoning). A small Patches/ pass renames the label, labelFemale and description on both the ThingDef and the PawnKindDef.
